name: input-otp
useFor: Use InputOTP for a short verification or pairing code. Set maxLength and lay out InputOTPSlot cells in one or two InputOTPGroup rows with an InputOTPSeparator between. Digits are the default; pass pattern=REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS_AND_CHARS for letters too. Label it with a visible label and htmlFor on the id.
constraints: Satoshi or display type in the cells
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the joined boxes of its changelog filter (.cl-filter), its quiet and strong lines, and Kode Mono for codes
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code on Base UI's OTP field: joined square 40px cells on the quiet rule, a 16px Kode Mono character in each, the cell with the caret on the strong edge; orange edges when invalid.
